name: Commerce
description: What is sold and how an order is assembled. Cart lines, prices, and the two addresses on an order live here. Parties live in the parties vocabulary this domain uses.

attributes.name: listPrice
attributes.description: The amount of money. Currency is the next attribute.

entities.name: Cart
entities.description: The shopper's collection of lines before it becomes an order.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: The states a cart can be in. What moves it between them is behavior.

entities.name: Cart line
entities.description: A cart line is an entity because the connection between a cart and a product carries a variant, a quantity, and a price. A relationship cannot hold those.

entities.name: Address
entities.description: A postal address. An order ships to one and is billed to one, which is two relationships, not two kinds of address.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: A placed cart. Money is an amount plus a currency. The shopper is a person in the parties domain.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Where the order is. Transitions between these states are behavior.

relationships.name: is for
relationships.description: Each line is one product. Variant and quantity sit on the line, not on this edge.

relationships.name: places
relationships.description: A person in the parties vocabulary places the order.

relationships.name: built from
relationships.description: The order is built from the cart the shopper accepted.

relationships.name: ships to
relationships.description: The address the order is shipped to.

relationships.name: billed to
relationships.description: The address the order is billed to. The same pair of entities as ships to, a different edge.
